question: Should restrictive spawned-child inheritance intentionally include every MCP/LSP tool that is present on the parent’s final policy-filtered and schema-compatible surface?
rationale: The branch makes a defensible and tested choice, but the intended inheritance boundary controls delegated tool authority and cannot be settled solely by mechanical correctness.

options.title: Confirm final-surface inheritance
options.body: Accept the patch’s model that a restrictive child cap mirrors concrete tools actually visible to the parent after final filtering.

options.title: Keep the earlier core-only cap
options.body: Reject this expansion if restrictive inheritance is intended to exclude deferred runtime tools even when the parent can invoke them.
